steps.en: Load the component with two lines on the page
steps.zh: 在页面上用两行挂起组件

steps.en: Shows a floating launcher; click an element to pin your note
steps.zh: 浮出入口；点选元素钉下批注

steps.en: Persists annotations locally, or to your REST store
steps.zh: 批注本地持久化，或写入你的 REST store

steps.en: Point at the UI, write the feedback in plain words
steps.zh: 指着界面，用大白话写反馈

steps.en: Compiles open items into one trust-bounded prompt via the handoff bar
steps.zh: handoff bar 把所有未关闭项编成一个信任有界的 prompt

steps.en: Or register the MCP server so the agent pulls them itself
steps.zh: 或注册 MCP 服务，让 agent 自己来拉

steps.en: Exposes only list_open_annotations until you opt into resolving
steps.zh: 未开允许 resolve 前只暴露只读工具

value.en: Feedback from a page you don't own becomes verifiable evidence for the agent — data to check, not instructions to obey.
value.zh: 来自一个不属于你的页面的反馈，变成 agent 可核实的证据——是待查的数据，不是照办的指令。
